title: MAPPED: 44 UFO sightings in the skies above Cornwall
excerpt: Our exclusive interactive map lets you see the details of all of them from the past five years - it's brilliant fun
content:
Our exclusive interactive map lets you see the details of all of them from the past five years - it's brilliant fun

16:00, 01 Nov 2026

Strange black triangles speeding above military sites have triggered security concerns in America – so we thought we'd show you where UFOs have been spotted in the skies above Cornwall. Nearly 2,000 Unidentified Flying Objects (UFOs) have been documented and logged in the UK over the past five years by research group UFO Identified.

‌

‌

Now, our searchable interactive map allows you to explore every one of the 44 unexplained encounter logged in Cornwall - and hundreds throughout the UK - between 2021 and 2026. Many of those British accounts closely mirror sightings reported across the Atlantic.

‌

In Cornwall, our interactive map below reveals details from the "moving flash of light over the Atlantic, flashing and moving around at different speeds" seen from Sennen in June of 2022 to the cylindrical "Tic-tac shaped object moving strangely in a clear sky, very high with no sound heard" above Bude a year earlier and the moment in November 2022 when "five bright continuous white lights high up in the sky, appeared out of a cloud after each other then disappeared".

‌

The 41 others in between include "two red stars dancing with each other before appearing to merge into and moving erratically" over Truro in October 2021, a "white cylindrical object crossing right to left, rounded ends and seemed to be partly transparent that travelled fast out of view" at Newquay in July of 2023 and a "huge luminous disc adorned with bright flashing lights spinning quicky appearing and disappearing and moving in different directions" just a year ago at St Ives.

The Pentagon recently published its latest release of declassified files on Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena (UAP – the American term for UFO), following an executive order signed by Donald Trump. Among the documents is an account from two federal agents stationed at a US “sensitive national security site” in June 2026.

According to the report, a matte-black triangular object with an estimated 15-foot wingspan hovered silently roughly 300 feet in the air for 20 seconds before descending into a canyon at high speed without leaving an exhaust trail.

‌

You can check what UFOs have been seen where you live using out interactive gadget

‌

While orbs, spheres and “star-like” sightings make up the bulk of British sightings, researchers have logged 164 reports of similar wedge-shaped objects – meaning roughly one in every 12 sightings involves a distinctive triangle.

Witnesses across the country have reported seeing dark, matte triangles gliding soundlessly at low altitude over housing estates, farmland, and coastal areas before darting away at incredible speeds, just like the sighting made by federal agents in the USA.

‌

The most recent was on July 22 of this year, when a “large black triangle” featuring a red light on each point was witnessed hovering over Stretford in Greater Manchester for over 30 minutes.

Earlier this year, a “perfect triangle” was seen speeding across the sky above Chesterfield in Derbyshire, a “black V-shaped boomerang” was spotted over the Fylde coast in Lancashire, and a soundless black wedge above Exmouth in Devon.

‌

Our map above reveals hotspot areas across the UK where clusters of UFOs have been spotted above Greater Manchester, London, Essex, Lancashire, Cheshire,Merseyside, Kent and West Yorkshire.

The accounts have been gathered by UFO Identified to create a central, searchable public archive, called the UK UFO Database, to help researchers identify patterns.

‌

Ash Ellis, founder of UFO Identified, said: “There are thousands of people across the UK who have seen something they could not readily explain, but the reports are often difficult to find once the initial interest has passed. We wanted to build a serious, easy-to-use public archive that keeps those accounts accessible and allows people to look for patterns for themselves.”

‌

To examine the UK UFO Database, or report sightings, visit: https://ukufodatabase.co.uk/
